title: hierochloe baltica
intro: Hierochloe baltica, commonly known as sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to Northern Europe, particularly in the Baltic region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting a sense of calmness. The therapeutic actions of Hierochloe baltica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may also help to alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of sweet grass include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
